evidence.notes: Queueable attachment and FinalizerContext execution are both asserted; the Salesforce API-67 probe passed the same lifecycle.

source.content: public class FinalizerLifecycleFixture implements Queueable, Finalizer { public void execute(QueueableContext context) { System.attachFinalizer(this); insert new Account(Name = 'GLADE_FINALIZER_QUEUEABLE'); } public void execute(FinalizerContext context) { System.assertEquals(ParentJobResult.SUCCESS, context.getResult()); System.assertNotEquals('', context.getAsyncApexJobId()); System.assertEquals(null, context.getException()); insert new Account(Name = 'GLADE_FINALIZER_EXECUTED'); } }

@IsTest private class FinalizerLifecycleFixtureTest { @IsTest static void finalizerRunsAfterQueueable() { Test.startTest(); System.enqueueJob(new FinalizerLifecycleFixture()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'GLADE_FINALIZER_QUEUEABLE']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'GLADE_FINALIZER_EXECUTED']); } }
